Requirement: System supports self-hosted login through Keycloak or Authentik with local fallback admin.
Acceptance Criteria: Authenticate to cockpit via OIDC and create first admin.

Requirement: System supports LAN, VPN-first and DMZ-first deployment profiles.
Acceptance Criteria: Deploy all three profiles in lab with documented runbook.

Requirement: Resource registry stores RDP, VNC, SSH, MeshCentral and workspace resources.
Acceptance Criteria: CRUD resources and enforce resource policy.

Requirement: Users can launch browser GUI sessions through Guacamole.
Acceptance Criteria: Open RDP and VNC resources from mobile and laptop browsers.

Requirement: Mobile viewer supports tap/click, long-press/right-click, two-finger scroll, zoom and soft keyboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass mobile usability test on iOS Safari and Android Chrome.

Requirement: Terminal sessions use xterm.js and tmux for persistence.
Acceptance Criteria: Disconnect/reconnect without killing command.

Requirement: Read-only demo links have expiry, passcode, watermark and revoke controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Create/revoke share link and verify no input allowed.

Requirement: All session actions emit audit events.
Acceptance Criteria: Audit contains user, resource, session, network profile and action metadata.

Requirement: MeshCentral adapter enrolls and controls managed PCs.
Acceptance Criteria: Enroll Windows/Linux/macOS test devices and open desktop/terminal/files.

Requirement: Desktop app runs a local background agent worker.
Acceptance Criteria: App can start/stop worker and show health.

Requirement: Model provider registry supports BYOK frontier APIs and OpenAI-compatible local/internal endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: Create model profiles for frontier, LiteLLM, Ollama, vLLM.

Requirement: Agent tool layer supports file read/write with diff, shell command request, git diff, and artifact output.
Acceptance Criteria: Agent completes safe local coding task with approval.

Requirement: Every risky tool call requires user approval by default.
Acceptance Criteria: Denied command stops execution and logs audit event.

Requirement: QR phone dispatch creates short-lived pairing session, not credential transfer.
Acceptance Criteria: QR expires, is single-use, and requires confirmation on both devices.

Requirement: Board supports projects, tickets, states, acceptance criteria, comments and attachments.
Acceptance Criteria: Create ticket and move across agent-native workflow.

Requirement: Ticket owns agent run timeline, approvals and evidence packet.
Acceptance Criteria: Agent run produces summary, diff, test log, artifact links.

Requirement: Board has agent-native states: Clarify, Planned, Ready for Agent, Running, Needs Approval, Evidence Review, Human Review, Done.
Acceptance Criteria: State transitions are validated by workflow engine.

Requirement: Board supports Scrum/Kanban/Lean/SAFe-inspired views.
Acceptance Criteria: Epics, sprints/cycles, WIP limits, dependencies and releases available.

Requirement: Confluence-style docs store PRDs, ADRs, runbooks, research notes and agent memory snapshots.
Acceptance Criteria: Docs can be linked to tickets, code, agent runs and releases.

Requirement: Integrate first with Gitea/Forgejo/GitLab/GitHub Enterprise before building native forge.
Acceptance Criteria: Ticket links to branch, PR, CI and release artifacts.

Requirement: No direct public exposure of SSH/RDP/VNC is permitted.
Acceptance Criteria: Network scan confirms only gateway ports are exposed.

Requirement: Clipboard, file transfer and control permissions are policy-gated per session.
Acceptance Criteria: Policy matrix tests pass.

Requirement: Offline release bundle includes container images, checksums, SBOM and install/upgrade/backup/restore scripts.
Acceptance Criteria: Install succeeds on isolated lab network.

Requirement: Agent sandboxing supports container/worktree first, microVM later.
Acceptance Criteria: Agent run cannot access unauthorized filesystem/network/secrets.
